name: Suspicious Button
description: A big red button blinks beside a sign that says, in tiny letters, 'probably fine'.

choices.label: Label It
choices.description: Gain a small thank-you prize for improving festival safety.
choices.resultText: The label reads: BUTTON. Everyone is wiser now.

choices.label: Press It
choices.description: Gain a rare reward and a random Oopsie.
choices.resultText: A prize pops out, followed by an apologetic little sproing.

choices.label: Walk Away
choices.description: Leave the button with its mystery intact.
choices.resultText: The button looks disappointed but respects your boundaries.
